Simon Weston ran a strong 'A' 800 metres to reduce his pb for the second time in a couple of weeks and another to break new ground was Wesley Swaffer who looked so positive in the 'chase and took metres out of Herne Hill's class performer Ben Woodd every time they tackled a barrier.
Stage two and Kevin Quinn, in his first year as a Senior, moved up two places while Herne Hill's Ben Woodd gained a half minute break on the field at the front.
